mountain_pose.name: Mountain Pose
mountain_pose.description: Foundational standing pose for grounding and alignment.
mountain_pose.instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, arms at sides. Distribute weight evenly, engage core, lengthen spine.
mountain_pose.modifications: Use wall support for balance, place block between thighs to engage legs.

upward_salute.name: Upward Salute
upward_salute.description: Standing pose with arms raised overhead.
upward_salute.instructions: From Mountain Pose, sweep arms overhead, palms facing each other or touching.
upward_salute.modifications: Keep hands on hips if shoulders are tight, bend elbows slightly.

forward_fold.name: Forward Fold
forward_fold.instructions: Hinge at hips, fold forward with straight spine. Let arms hang or rest on legs.
forward_fold.modifications: Bend knees generously, use blocks under hands, hold opposite elbows.

halfway_lift.name: Halfway Lift
halfway_lift.description: Partial forward fold with flat back
halfway_lift.instructions: From forward fold, place hands on shins or fingertips to floor, flatten back.
halfway_lift.modifications: Hands to thighs or blocks, focus on long spine over depth.

low_push_up.name: Chaturanga
low_push_up.instructions: From plank, lower down keeping elbows close to body, hover above ground.
low_push_up.modifications: Drop knees to ground, use blocks under chest, skip and go to child's pose.

upward_dog.name: Upward Dog
upward_dog.description: Backbend with arms supporting body weight
upward_dog.instructions: Press hands down, lift chest and thighs off ground, open heart forward.
upward_dog.modifications: Keep thighs on ground (cobra variation), use blocks under hands.

downward_dog.name: Downward Dog
downward_dog.instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, feet hip-width apart, lift hips up and back.
downward_dog.modifications: Bend knees, pedal feet, use blocks under hands, forearms down.

chair_pose.name: Chair Pose
chair_pose.instructions: Bend knees, sit back as if sitting in chair, arms overhead.
chair_pose.modifications: Hands on hips, back against wall, less depth in squat.

warrior_i_right.name: Warrior I Right
warrior_i_right.description: Standing lunge with right foot forward, arms overhead
warrior_i_right.instructions: Step right foot forward, bend right knee over ankle, square hips forward, arms up.
warrior_i_right.modifications: Narrow stance for balance, hands on hips, use wall support.

warrior_i_left.name: Warrior I Left
warrior_i_left.description: Standing lunge with left foot forward, arms overhead
warrior_i_left.instructions: Step left foot forward, bend left knee over ankle, square hips forward, arms up.
warrior_i_left.modifications: Narrow stance for balance, hands on hips, use wall support.

warrior_ii_right.name: Warrior II Right
warrior_ii_right.description: Standing lunge with right foot forward, arms parallel to ground
warrior_ii_right.instructions: Wide stance, bend right knee, arms parallel to floor, gaze over right hand.
warrior_ii_right.modifications: Shorter stance, hand on front thigh, use wall behind back leg.

warrior_ii_left.name: Warrior II Left
warrior_ii_left.description: Standing lunge with left foot forward, arms parallel to ground
warrior_ii_left.instructions: Wide stance, bend left knee, arms parallel to floor, gaze over left hand.
warrior_ii_left.modifications: Shorter stance, hand on front thigh, use wall behind back leg.

warrior_iii_right.name: Warrior III Right
warrior_iii_right.description: Standing balance on right leg with left leg lifted
warrior_iii_right.instructions: Stand on right leg, lift left leg behind, torso forward, arms extended.
warrior_iii_right.modifications: Use wall support, hands on hips, keep toe of lifted leg on ground.

warrior_iii_left.name: Warrior III Left
warrior_iii_left.description: Standing balance on left leg with right leg lifted
warrior_iii_left.instructions: Stand on left leg, lift right leg behind, torso forward, arms extended.
warrior_iii_left.modifications: Use wall support, hands on hips, keep toe of lifted leg on ground.

side_angle_right.name: Side Angle Right
side_angle_right.description: Side stretch from Warrior II with right foot forward
side_angle_right.instructions: From Warrior II right, place right hand on thigh or floor, reach left arm over ear.
side_angle_right.modifications: Hand stays on thigh, use block under bottom hand, take bind under front thigh.

side_angle_left.name: Side Angle Left
side_angle_left.description: Side stretch from Warrior II with left foot forward
side_angle_left.instructions: From Warrior II left, place left hand on thigh or floor, reach right arm over ear.
side_angle_left.modifications: Hand stays on thigh, use block under bottom hand, take bind under front thigh.

vinyasa_flow.name: Vinyasa Flow
vinyasa_flow.instructions: Flow through plank, low push-up, upward dog, downward dog.
vinyasa_flow.modifications: Skip challenging poses, step back/forward instead of jumping.

easy_pose.name: Easy Pose
easy_pose.instructions: Sit cross-legged, hands on knees or in lap, spine tall.
easy_pose.modifications: Sit on block or blanket, lean against wall, extend legs if uncomfortable.

gentle_neck_rolls.name: Gentle Neck Rolls
gentle_neck_rolls.description: Slow circular movements to warm neck
gentle_neck_rolls.instructions: Slowly roll head in semicircles, avoid full circles, move mindfully.
gentle_neck_rolls.modifications: Just turn head side to side, support head with hand.

seated_cat_cow.name: Seated Cat-Cow
seated_cat_cow.instructions: Arch and round spine while seated, coordinate with breath.
seated_cat_cow.modifications: Smaller movements, hand support on knees.

seated_twist_right.name: Seated Twist Right
seated_twist_right.description: Spinal rotation to the right while seated
seated_twist_right.instructions: Sit tall, place right hand behind right hip, left hand on right knee, twist right.
seated_twist_right.modifications: Use chair back for support, smaller range of motion.

seated_twist_left.name: Seated Twist Left
seated_twist_left.description: Spinal rotation to the left while seated
seated_twist_left.instructions: Sit tall, place left hand behind left hip, right hand on left knee, twist left.
seated_twist_left.modifications: Use chair back for support, smaller range of motion.

forward_fold_seated.name: Forward Fold Seated
forward_fold_seated.instructions: Hinge at hips, fold forward over legs, keep spine long.
forward_fold_seated.modifications: Bend knees, use strap around feet, place pillow on legs.

childs_pose.name: Child's Pose
childs_pose.instructions: Kneel, sit back on heels, fold forward, arms extended or at sides.
childs_pose.modifications: Place pillow between calves and thighs, widen knees, use bolster.

table_top.name: Table Top
table_top.instructions: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, neutral spine.
table_top.modifications: Place blanket under knees, use blocks under hands if wrists hurt.

cat_cow_stretches.name: Cat-Cow Stretches
cat_cow_stretches.description: Spinal mobility on hands and knees
cat_cow_stretches.instructions: Alternate between arching (cow) and rounding (cat) the spine.
cat_cow_stretches.modifications: Smaller movements, move slowly, support knees with blanket.

low_lunge_right.name: Low Lunge Right
low_lunge_right.description: Kneeling lunge with right foot forward
low_lunge_right.instructions: Step right foot forward, lower left knee, hands on right thigh or floor.
low_lunge_right.modifications: Place blanket under back knee, use blocks under hands.

low_lunge_left.name: Low Lunge Left
low_lunge_left.description: Kneeling lunge with left foot forward
low_lunge_left.instructions: Step left foot forward, lower right knee, hands on left thigh or floor.
low_lunge_left.modifications: Place blanket under back knee, use blocks under hands.

lizard_pose_right.name: Lizard Pose Right
lizard_pose_right.description: Deep hip opener with right foot forward
lizard_pose_right.instructions: From low lunge right, place both hands inside right foot, lower to forearms if possible.
lizard_pose_right.modifications: Stay on hands, use blocks under forearms, keep back knee down.

lizard_pose_left.name: Lizard Pose Left
lizard_pose_left.description: Deep hip opener with left foot forward
lizard_pose_left.instructions: From low lunge left, place both hands inside left foot, lower to forearms if possible.
lizard_pose_left.modifications: Stay on hands, use blocks under forearms, keep back knee down.

half_pigeon_right.name: Half Pigeon Right
half_pigeon_right.description: Deep hip opener with right knee bent in front
half_pigeon_right.instructions: Right knee bent in front, left leg straight back, sit upright or fold forward.
half_pigeon_right.modifications: Place block or pillow under right hip, stay upright, use wall support.

half_pigeon_left.name: Half Pigeon Left
half_pigeon_left.description: Deep hip opener with left knee bent in front
half_pigeon_left.instructions: Left knee bent in front, right leg straight back, sit upright or fold forward.
half_pigeon_left.modifications: Place block or pillow under left hip, stay upright, use wall support.

low_cobra.name: Low Cobra
low_cobra.instructions: Lie on belly, hands under shoulders, lift chest using back muscles.
low_cobra.modifications: Keep forearms down, very small lift, place pillow under hips.

cobra_pose.name: Cobra Pose
cobra_pose.instructions: Press hands down, straighten arms, lift chest, keep hips grounded.
cobra_pose.modifications: Stay on forearms, press hands lightly, use block between thighs.

camel_pose.name: Camel Pose
camel_pose.description: Deep backbend kneeling with hands to heels
camel_pose.instructions: Kneel, place hands on heels, lift chest and hips forward.
camel_pose.modifications: Hands on lower back, use blocks on calves, tuck toes under.

camel_pose_prep.name: Camel Pose Prep
camel_pose_prep.instructions: Kneel, hands on lower back, lean back gently, open chest.
camel_pose_prep.modifications: Hands stay on hips, use wall behind back, place block between thighs.

bridge_pose.name: Bridge Pose
bridge_pose.description: Backbend lying on back with knees bent
bridge_pose.instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat, lift hips, press feet down.
bridge_pose.modifications: Place block between thighs, use strap around thighs, support with bolster.

fish_pose.name: Fish Pose
fish_pose.instructions: Lie on back, hands under glutes, lift chest, crown of head touches floor.
fish_pose.modifications: Use bolster under shoulder blades, keep head lifted slightly.

supine_spinal_twist_right.name: Supine Spinal Twist Right
supine_spinal_twist_right.description: Lying spinal rotation dropping knees to the right
supine_spinal_twist_right.instructions: Lie on back, draw knees to chest, drop both knees to right side.
supine_spinal_twist_right.modifications: Place pillow between legs, support knees with bolster.

supine_spinal_twist_left.name: Supine Spinal Twist Left
supine_spinal_twist_left.description: Lying spinal rotation dropping knees to the left
supine_spinal_twist_left.instructions: Lie on back, draw knees to chest, drop both knees to left side.
supine_spinal_twist_left.modifications: Place pillow between legs, support knees with bolster.

seated_forward_fold.name: Seated Forward Fold
seated_forward_fold.description: Forward bend from seated position with legs extended
seated_forward_fold.instructions: Sit with legs extended, hinge at hips, fold forward over legs.
seated_forward_fold.modifications: Bend knees, use strap around feet, sit on blanket.

supine_knee_to_chest.name: Supine Knee to Chest
supine_knee_to_chest.description: Gentle hip release lying on back
supine_knee_to_chest.instructions: Lie on back, hug knees to chest, rock side to side if desired.
supine_knee_to_chest.modifications: Keep one foot on ground, use strap around thighs.

happy_baby_pose.name: Happy Baby Pose
happy_baby_pose.description: Playful hip opener lying on back
happy_baby_pose.instructions: Lie on back, grab outside edges of feet, knees toward armpits.
happy_baby_pose.modifications: Hold behind thighs instead, use strap around feet, rock side to side.

knees_to_chest.name: Knees to Chest
knees_to_chest.instructions: Lie on back, hug both knees into chest, breathe deeply.
knees_to_chest.modifications: Keep head on ground, place pillow behind head.

savasana.name: Savasana
savasana.instructions: Lie on back, arms and legs relaxed, close eyes, focus on breath.
savasana.modifications: Place pillow under knees, blanket over body, bolster under knees.

wide_legged_forward_fold.name: Wide Legged Forward Fold
wide_legged_forward_fold.description: Forward fold with wide leg stance
wide_legged_forward_fold.instructions: Stand with legs wide, hinge at hips, fold forward with hands to floor.
wide_legged_forward_fold.modifications: Hands on blocks, bend knees, hands on shins instead of floor.

triangle_pose_right.name: Triangle Pose Right
triangle_pose_right.description: Standing side stretch with right foot forward
triangle_pose_right.instructions: Wide stance, right foot forward, reach right hand to ankle/shin, left arm up.
triangle_pose_right.modifications: Use block under bottom hand, hand on shin instead of ankle.

triangle_pose_left.name: Triangle Pose Left
triangle_pose_left.description: Standing side stretch with left foot forward
triangle_pose_left.instructions: Wide stance, left foot forward, reach left hand to ankle/shin, right arm up.
triangle_pose_left.modifications: Use block under bottom hand, hand on shin instead of ankle.

revolved_triangle_right.name: Revolved Triangle Right
revolved_triangle_right.description: Twisting triangle with right foot forward
revolved_triangle_right.instructions: Wide stance, right foot forward, left hand to right foot, right arm up.
revolved_triangle_right.modifications: Use block under bottom hand, hand on shin, bend front knee.

revolved_triangle_left.name: Revolved Triangle Left
revolved_triangle_left.description: Twisting triangle with left foot forward
revolved_triangle_left.instructions: Wide stance, left foot forward, right hand to left foot, left arm up.
revolved_triangle_left.modifications: Use block under bottom hand, hand on shin, bend front knee.

tree_pose_right.name: Tree Pose Right
tree_pose_right.description: Standing balance on right leg with left foot on inner thigh
tree_pose_right.instructions: Stand on right leg, place left foot on right inner thigh, hands at heart or overhead.
tree_pose_right.modifications: Use wall support, foot on calf instead of thigh, toe on ground for balance.

tree_pose_left.name: Tree Pose Left
tree_pose_left.description: Standing balance on left leg with right foot on inner thigh
tree_pose_left.instructions: Stand on left leg, place right foot on left inner thigh, hands at heart or overhead.
tree_pose_left.modifications: Use wall support, foot on calf instead of thigh, toe on ground for balance.

eagle_pose.name: Eagle Pose
eagle_pose.description: Standing balance pose with wrapped arms and legs
eagle_pose.instructions: Stand on one leg, wrap other leg around, cross arms and bring palms together.
eagle_pose.modifications: Use wall for balance, keep wrapped toe on ground, just cross arms.

eagle_pose_right.name: Eagle Pose Right
eagle_pose_right.description: Eagle pose standing on right leg
eagle_pose_right.instructions: Stand on right leg, wrap left leg around, cross arms and bring palms together.
eagle_pose_right.modifications: Use wall for balance, keep wrapped toe on ground, just cross arms.

eagle_pose_left.name: Eagle Pose Left
eagle_pose_left.description: Eagle pose standing on left leg
eagle_pose_left.instructions: Stand on left leg, wrap right leg around, cross arms and bring palms together.
eagle_pose_left.modifications: Use wall for balance, keep wrapped toe on ground, just cross arms.

dancer_pose_right.name: Dancer Pose Right
dancer_pose_right.description: Dancer pose standing on right leg
dancer_pose_right.instructions: Stand on right leg, grab left ankle, kick into hand while leaning forward.
dancer_pose_right.modifications: Use wall support, hold with strap, just lift leg without grabbing.

dancer_pose_left.name: Dancer Pose Left
dancer_pose_left.description: Dancer pose standing on left leg
dancer_pose_left.instructions: Stand on left leg, grab right ankle, kick into hand while leaning forward.
dancer_pose_left.modifications: Use wall support, hold with strap, just lift leg without grabbing.

plank_pose.name: Plank Pose
plank_pose.description: Straight arm plank for core strength
plank_pose.instructions: Hands under shoulders, body in straight line from head to heels.
plank_pose.modifications: Drop knees to ground, forearm plank, hands on elevated surface.

boat_pose.name: Boat Pose
boat_pose.instructions: Sit, lift legs and lean back, balancing on sitting bones, arms forward.
boat_pose.modifications: Bend knees, hands behind thighs, feet on floor.

bicycle_pose.name: Bicycle Pose
bicycle_pose.description: Dynamic core exercise with rotating movement
bicycle_pose.instructions: Lie on back, hands behind head, bicycle legs while twisting torso.
bicycle_pose.modifications: Slower movement, smaller range of motion, hands on chest.

side_plank_right.name: Side Plank Right
side_plank_right.instructions: Lie on right side, prop up on right forearm, lift hips, body in straight line.
side_plank_right.modifications: Bottom knee on ground, left hand on hip, stay on forearm.

side_plank_left.name: Side Plank Left
side_plank_left.instructions: Lie on left side, prop up on left forearm, lift hips, body in straight line.
side_plank_left.modifications: Bottom knee on ground, right hand on hip, stay on forearm.

hollow_body_hold.name: Hollow Body Hold
hollow_body_hold.description: Isometric core hold with curved spine
hollow_body_hold.instructions: Lie on back, press lower back down, lift shoulders and legs.
hollow_body_hold.modifications: Bend knees, hands behind head, smaller lift.

crow_pose.name: Crow Pose
crow_pose.description: Arm balance with knees on upper arms
crow_pose.instructions: Squat, hands on floor, lean forward, lift feet, balance on hands.
crow_pose.modifications: Keep toes on ground, use block under forehead, practice on higher surface.

side_crow_right.name: Side Crow Right
side_crow_right.description: Side crow with twist to the right
side_crow_right.instructions: Twist right, place hands on floor, hook legs on right arm, lift feet.
side_crow_right.modifications: Keep one foot on ground, use block under shoulder.

side_crow_left.name: Side Crow Left
side_crow_left.description: Side crow with twist to the left
side_crow_left.instructions: Twist left, place hands on floor, hook legs on left arm, lift feet.
side_crow_left.modifications: Keep one foot on ground, use block under shoulder.

standing_forward_fold.name: Standing Forward Fold
standing_forward_fold.description: Standing forward bend with feet together
standing_forward_fold.instructions: Stand with feet together, hinge at hips, fold forward over legs.
standing_forward_fold.modifications: Bend knees, cross arms and sway, hands on blocks or shins.

butterfly_pose.name: Butterfly Pose
butterfly_pose.description: Seated hip opener with soles of feet together
butterfly_pose.instructions: Sit with soles of feet together, hold feet, gently draw heels toward pelvis.
butterfly_pose.modifications: Sit on blanket, place blocks under knees, lean against wall.

dragon_pose_right.name: Dragon Pose Right
dragon_pose_right.description: Dragon pose with right foot forward
dragon_pose_right.instructions: Right foot forward in lunge, slide foot forward, sink hips down.
dragon_pose_right.modifications: Place bolster under right thigh, hands on blocks, left knee down.

dragon_pose_left.name: Dragon Pose Left
dragon_pose_left.description: Dragon pose with left foot forward
dragon_pose_left.instructions: Left foot forward in lunge, slide foot forward, sink hips down.
dragon_pose_left.modifications: Place bolster under left thigh, hands on blocks, right knee down.

supported_fish_pose.name: Supported Fish Pose
supported_fish_pose.instructions: Lie back over bolster placed under shoulder blades, arms open wide.
supported_fish_pose.modifications: Use blanket instead of bolster, pillow under head, legs elevated.

seated_spinal_twist_right.name: Seated Spinal Twist Right
seated_spinal_twist_right.description: Seated spinal twist rotating to the right
seated_spinal_twist_right.instructions: Sit with right leg crossed over, twist right, right hand behind back.
seated_spinal_twist_right.modifications: Sit on blanket, use wall for support, smaller range of motion.

seated_spinal_twist_left.name: Seated Spinal Twist Left
seated_spinal_twist_left.description: Seated spinal twist rotating to the left
seated_spinal_twist_left.instructions: Sit with left leg crossed over, twist left, left hand behind back.
seated_spinal_twist_left.modifications: Sit on blanket, use wall for support, smaller range of motion.

legs_up_wall.name: Legs Up Wall
legs_up_wall.instructions: Lie on back near wall, extend legs up wall, arms relaxed at sides.
legs_up_wall.modifications: Use bolster under lower back, bend knees, eye pillow for relaxation.

dolphin_pose.name: Dolphin Pose
dolphin_pose.instructions: Forearms on floor, lift hips like downward dog, press forearms down.
dolphin_pose.modifications: Keep head down, use wall for support, bend knees.

headstand_prep.name: Headstand Prep
headstand_prep.instructions: Forearms down, crown of head on floor, lift hips, walk feet closer.
headstand_prep.modifications: Practice against wall, keep feet on ground, use blanket under head.

shoulder_stand.name: Shoulder Stand
shoulder_stand.instructions: Lie on back, lift legs overhead, support back with hands.
shoulder_stand.modifications: Use wall for support, legs in easy pose, blanket under shoulders.
